title: Carthage National Museum
scope: Carthage National Museum in the former White Fathers seminary, with its white masonry ranges, open cloister court and connected lower wings on Byrsa Hill.
limitations: The scene depicts the documented historic seminary buildings before any new competition interventions. Hidden exterior openings, roof parapets, internal court grading and the annex eaves are estimates.
The adjacent cathedral, archaeological ruins, excavated artifacts, modern equipment and future museum fit-out are outside the modeled footprint.
